from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485762/attempts/600043634274485a8fca1406353e4b51/system/state/workspace/programs/task-99040758.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    copies = sum(v == 4 for row in grid for v in row)
    return [sum((row[:] for _ in range(copies)), []) for row in shape]
'''
p.write_text(code)
